description: Clear out the three food items that expired before September 2026.
rationale: The date is written literally rather than as CURRENT_DATE, because a signed migration must do the same thing whenever it runs: a relative date would delete a different set on every database it reached, and the ledger would record a statement whose meaning depends on when somebody deployed. Deleting the house.food row leaves the house.item row behind, which is wrong, so the delete is on house.item and food_item_fk cascades -- one statement, and the cascade is declared in the schema rather than emitted here.

intents.where: item.category = 'food' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM house.food AS f WHERE f.item_id = item.item_id AND f.expiry_date < DATE '2026-09-01')
intents.verify_remaining: category = 'food' AND item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM house.food WHERE expiry_date < DATE '2026-09-01')

assert_invariants.name: no_orphan_food_detail
assert_invariants.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM house.food f LEFT JOIN house.item i ON i.item_id = f.item_id WHERE i.item_id IS NULL
